# `liber:ptp-transport@1`

Generated reference for the `liber:ptp-transport` package (`ptp-transport.lsidl`). See [the LSIDL language](../../../LSIDL.md).

LiberSystem PTP transport - the private contract a `ptp-transport` publication serves to MediaImportService.  BYTES OUT, BYTES IN, AND NOTHING UNDERSTOOD. The USB Still Image class module, and the kernel's responder fixture before it, sends one command container, returns bulk-IN bytes as they arrive, delivers event containers, cancels the active transaction and resets the device. It bounds every frame before it copies it and parses none of them: container lengths, types and codes, transaction IDs, sessions, datasets and the order of data and responses are validated once, by the service.

## Interfaces

### interface `ptp-transport`

THE TRANSPORT CONTRACT, served to MediaImportService alone. One transaction at a time.

Request `[op u16][corr u32][args]`, reply `[corr u32][result]`.

| op | method | signature | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `attach` | `attach(version: u32) -> result<ptp-attach, error>` |  |
| 2 | `command` | `command(attachment: u64, container: list<u8>) -> result<unit, error>` | ONE COMMAND CONTAINER, sent whole or not at all. An error means it may or may not have left: the service ends the session rather than send it again. |
| 3 | `pull` | `pull(attachment: u64, max: u16) -> result<list<u8>, error>` | Up to `max` bulk-IN bytes, as they arrived. `again` when none have yet - never an empty success, and never a response the device did not send. |
| 4 | `events` | `events() -> stream<ptp-event>` | Event containers as the device sends them, eight at most waiting. |
| 5 | `cancel` | `cancel(attachment: u64) -> result<unit, error>` | Cancel the active transaction. |
| 6 | `reset` | `reset(attachment: u64) -> result<ptp-attach, error>` | Reset the device. A new attachment on success; the old one is gone either way. |
